selected_concept: An incomplete sculptural bridge leaves a clear break between two banks; publication cannot cross an unsupported source chain.

notes.concept: Two arch halves with a broken deck do show an incomplete span, but the segmented ring still reads as a dial.
notes.focal_hierarchy: The gap between the two halves is the clear focal point and reads first at 300 px.
notes.composition: Subject sits centered above the headline band with calm negative space; the deck offsets are slightly unbalanced.
notes.color_value: Cream, coral and teal separate clearly against the plum ground at thumbnail scale.
notes.detail_richness: Ring joints and deck edges are visible at full size, but the large forms carry little meaningful assembly detail.
notes.craft_finish: Shadows and plinths sit cleanly; the deck ends meet the plinths without loose strokes.
notes.typography: Two-line headline is legible at 300 px with clear margins and no overlap with the subject.
notes.originality: Broken-span treatment is distinct from recent covers but close to a generic gauge or dial motif.
notes.story_fidelity: The incomplete-evidence metaphor is declared, but the dial reading risks suggesting a measurement rather than an unfinished chain.

blockers: Reads as a gauge or dial rather than an unfinished evidence chain, a misleading mechanism read.
eval_history.observations: Best observed pass (render 3, identical bytes on re-render). Stronger than earlier passes; still reads as a gauge.
eval_history.edit_prompt: Replace the segmented ring with masonry voussoirs and a level deck so the gap reads as a bridge, then re-render.
